description: Reno Raines goes from detective to escaped fugitive to bounty hunter after a crooked fellow cop kills his wife and frames him for the murder.

children.description: By returning home to honor the one-year anniversary of his fiancee's death, Reno puts himself precariously close to Lt. Dixon's deadly clutches.
children.title: S02:E01 - The Hound

children.description: Reno may have met his match when Bobby sends him after a former heavyweight boxing champion turned convicted killer.
children.title: S02:E02 - The Champ

children.description: When Reno attempts to bust his latest bounty at a railway station, the man slips from his grasp and the station, but not before stealing a car and killing the owner.
children.title: S02:E03 - White Picket Fences

children.description: When Reno attempts to bust an athletic beachcomber wanted for the armed robbery of a police van, he is blind sided by a female bounty hunter
children.title: S02:E04 - Dead End and Easy Money

children.description: Armed robber Andy DuPree, has managed to allude authorities across the country and has once again returned to his hometown for his next round of scores.
children.title: S02:E05 - No Good Deed

children.description: When a beautiful, young Mafia wife is framed for the murder of her husband, she fears for her life.
children.title: S02:E06 - The Rabbit and the Fox

children.description: When Reno tracks down assault and battery suspect Jason Calhoun, the head of a gang of surfers, he is immediately enthralled by the young man's charisma.

children.description: Reno and Bobby learn to never underestimate the power of a woman when they encounter a beautiful, young bail jumper.

children.title: S02:E09 - Wheel Men Don't Eat Quiche

children.title: S02:E10 - Windy City Blues

children.description: A distinguished municipal judge awakes after an intimate evening to find his "date" murdered during the night.
children.title: S02:E11 - Honor Bound

children.description: When a UNLV coed is kidnapped following a frat party, Bobby is hired by her father to deliver the two million dollar ransom and ensure the 18-year-old honor student's safe return.
